g.text: Across candidates and coupons, Spearman ρ(peak T, |r_H|) = 0.97 and ρ(peak T, |r_W|) = -0.12: the best H agreement comes at the coolest peaks,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: not at temperatures above boiling. The regulator is a surface loss above 3133 K, not a cap (T5).
